continuation_boundary: International follow-up dataset; separate from the earlier domestic baseline.

privacy.included: public post titles, descriptions, tags, comment text, public engagement counts, province/country public location, canonical note URLs, relationship and pagination evidence
privacy.excluded: cookies, browser/session state, signed access URLs, xsec tokens, media URLs, crawler logs, proxy/egress details, device/account identifiers, nicknames and raw author/commenter identifiers
privacy.identity_method: HMAC-SHA256 stable anonymous identifiers; key stored outside repository
privacy.text_method: public text retained; detected PII fragments replaced in place and counted

deduplication.notes: note_id; latest last_modify_ts with text completeness tie-break
deduplication.comments: (note_id, comment_id); latest last_modify_ts with content completeness tie-break
deduplication.progress: (phase_id, chunk); terminal result preferred, latest finished_at tie-break

completion_claim: All 2,630 frozen targets have one effective terminal outcome. Public text is present for all accessible landed records; inaccessible targets remain explicit rows.
